title: Book 1: Sanctuary on Caelum-IV (Stardate 49601)
description: Having reached escape velocity and shattered the gravitational pull of the corporate Cage, the crew of the U.S.S. Aethelgard sets down on Caelum-IV ('Sanctuary')—the outer rocky moon of the ringed gas giant Vespera (Kepler-442c). Under a permanent golden-violet twilight, the family lowers the aft cargo ramp onto compacted basaltic purple sand and discovers a planetary intelligence that communicates entirely through sympathetic musical resonance.
